protocol: Edition023 blackswan, car-shadow and hike results are now known development cases. They are never described as unseen again.

Development may additionally use the declared consecutive hike frames and independent synthetic controls. New evaluation images/masks are fetched only after candidate, evaluator and negative controls are committed and source hashes recorded.

One first-frame reference rectangle initializes each tracker. No later mask or annotation enters the tracker. All subsequent selected frames count, including losses as IoU zero; no reset or omitted failures.

Consecutive frames are required for temporal tracking. Edition023 used uniformly spaced frames, so numerical gains across those protocols are not comparable. Both profiles get the same new pixels/initialization here.
After the first new evaluation, record it unchanged and do not retune this candidate on those clips. Later runs prove reproducibility/software behavior only.

Report per-sequence and pooled mean IoU, IoU>=0.5 coverage, IoU<0.1 visible errors, lost/reacquired observations and decode+tracking latency. Include failures and negative controls. No official DAVIS mask score or general semantic/face recognition claim.
No new model weights, OpenCV runtime or neural/LLM training is required. Pure Java CPU image processing; GPU acceleration is not claimed.
baseline: Unchanged rgb-v1 from edition022; adaptive-v2 remains installed for existing goals/skills. New comparisons test flow-v3 against rgb-v1.
